oil.when: 2016 GLC with the ASSYST PLUS service display
steps: Have the oil, filter and scheduled service done first; the reminder is tied to the service actually being carried out.
The 2016 owner's manual gives no driver reset. It says the workshop that does the service resets the ASSYST PLUS service display afterward.

To see when the next service is due: switch the ignition on, use the steering wheel buttons to open the menu list, choose Service, then ASSYST PLUS. The due date shows in the instrument cluster display.
If the service display was reset by mistake, the manual says a qualified workshop can correct it.

tpms.when: 2016–2018 GLC SUV with the tire pressure monitor in the cluster Service menu
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire and loading sticker in the driver's door opening (or the table inside the fuel filler flap).
Switch the ignition on (key in position 2) and stay parked.
Use the steering wheel buttons to open the menu list, choose Service and press OK.
Choose Tire Pressure and press OK. The current pressures show, or a message that they will appear after a few minutes of driving.
Press the down arrow button. The display asks whether to use the current pressures as the new reference values.
Press OK to confirm. The display shows that the tire pressure monitor has restarted.
Drive for a few minutes. The car checks the pressures and stores them as the new reference.
tpms.note: If the tire warning lamp flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the monitor itself has a fault, and a restart will not clear it.

notes: The 2016 GLC owner's manual says the workshop resets the ASSYST PLUS service reminder after the service, so no driver steps are given for it.
